description: This source file defines an Angular standalone component 'SignupComponent' used for user registration, presenting a sign-up form with email and password inputs, including event handling for form submission and navigation to login.

classes.name: SignupComponent
classes.description: Angular component handling user sign-up UI and logic, emitting events upon form submission and navigation to login screen.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, prevents default event, resets error state, sets loading indicator, and emits signup data.

methods.name: showLogin
methods.description: Handles click on login link, prevents default, and emits event to switch to login view.
